Q: power bi: dynamic y-scale values based on data A:

If your visual is a line diagram then you can solve it by adding two additional measures to the plot:

y_top = MAX([pct_measure])+0,1
y_bottom = MIN([pct_measure])-0,1

Add both to the line diagram and then set their line widths to 0.

It's a variation of this:

Power Bi Tips - Center X-axis on a line chart

Q: How to set X-Frame-Options header in angularjs? A:

$httpProvider.defaults is used to set request headers. Leaving aside your error in how you are trying to use it, X-Frame-Options is a response header.

You can't set response headers in Angular: It is a client-side application.

You need to configure your HTTP server (https://10.11.12.13) to include the header.

How you do that depends on which HTTP server software you use. This guide, for example, covers Apache HTTPD and Nginx. You'll need to find documentation for the software you are using.

Q: Eclipse - Target "unknown" in Android device chooser A:

Check your device that

  • USB connected, and
  • USB debugging connected

Or check the following:

The solution was to create a udev rule for the device. See http://developer.android.com/guide/developing/device.html#setting-up for how to set up a udev rule for your specific vendor device.

With the rule in place, Eclipse was able to launch and debug.

Q: Python ast.literal_eval: raw strings recommended? A:

This warning is due to changes in future versions of Python. Unrecognized escape sequences will result in a SyntaxError. Therefore, using "r" may be necessary if a string contains a backslash that is not an escape sequence but is a literal backslash character.
